walkthroughs.body_html:
BPS Code (2018) plus requirements.

Key principles: informed consent, right to withdraw, confidentiality, protection from harm, no deception unless justified, debriefing.

Animal research: 3Rs (Replace, Reduce, Refine) under the UK Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986.

The target population is the whole group of interest; the sample is a subset.

Random: each member has equal chance — strong, expensive.
Stratified: proportional by subgroup — representative.
Opportunity: convenient — biased.
Snowball: existing participants recruit others — useful for hidden populations.

Reliability: a measure gives consistent results (test-retest, inter-rater).

Validity: it measures what we claim — internal (causal logic), external (generalisability), ecological (real settings).

A measure can be reliable without being valid (a broken thermometer always reads 20°C).
